findings.title: Cancellation can win after the final pre-dispatch check yet the configuration adapter is still invoked
Batch cleanup did not recheck an external writer after taking the HOME lease
Failed configuration calls revoke the captured admission certificate with record CAS
Credential or dependency rotation during failure cannot redirect revocation from the captured scope
Preflight rejection without a captured verification reference preserves a newer certificate
Concurrent proposal completion returns a coherent state and payload snapshot
A native transcript change before the batch lease is detected and aborts all cleanup side effects

limitations: Identity was independently rechecked on the read-only candidate: all 203 manifest entries match, its computed candidate hash is 47834be371b76c45af8378462134293a1e98a56d0b60fddb1c4729760f4c6917, and the declared reconstructed Git tree is 6ece96773b719c3bc70b04f928788831ee0ffc0b. The contract hash also matches 5cb10d9a31d8c603db4a07151dfdf39fff32fcda3893e1061cfe3d03d931c352.

The two shipped pre-dispatch cases pass: cancellation already queued before work, and cancellation injected during HOME-lease acquisition, both avoid CLI.start and preserve the certificate. The post-dispatch/result-publication cancellation case also ends CANCELLED.

However, the retained and re-run bounded counterexample injects the durable cancellation immediately after ConfigurationAssistant.execute() performs its last session-operation cancellation read and before the subsequent CLI.start call. CLI.start is invoked with cancel_requested=true. The synthetic success path also showed proposal/receipt publication and certificate renewal despite final CANCELLED; the synthetic failure path showed certificate invalidation. This is a real TOCTOU interval in current source, not a failed test assertion or a model invocation. It keeps the original SC06 P1 finding OPEN.

The current batch fix was independently exercised with the shipped owned OS child that becomes a claude-named writer with the target synthetic HOME after lease acquisition. It aborts the complete cleanup with no session metadata/native-history change. Own-held lease cleanup succeeds; post-scan native identity change and new queued writer remain rejected. Accordingly the original SC04 P2 finding is closed.

The bounded R2 suite completed 45 tests successfully, but its adversarial final-read race test intentionally observes the adapter call rather than treating it as a passing safety property. No broad suite, browser suite, model call, credential/authentication read, source write, authority write, Git operation, Stable operation, or external publication was performed in this continuation.

Sealed current evidence records 715 Python, 6 host, 56 JS/editor-projection, and ordinary HTTP/Chromium coverage, plus real native/session and AI-configuration evidence. It was inspected rather than replayed here. The normal-host six-test result is an external-runner record; it is not substituted for a local nested-namespace run. Nested namespace limitations remain distinct and preserved.

The initial current browser full run interruption at case 67 remains visible: a route callback raised TypeError while reading missing prepare-response data and the original response body was unavailable, so its exact cause remains unproven. A diagnostic full 82-case run, five targeted repetitions, and a later full 82-case run passed with HTTP error logging only. This supports current coverage but is not represented as a source fix or proven environmental explanation.

Real records support model-directory configuration, configuration generation/apply, workflow execution, and same-UUID native Codex/Claude Q/A. They do not establish physical backend identity or effective effort, which remain unknown. Registration remains separate from execution admission; applying a proposal remains draft-only even when an Agent-mode proposal visibly requests later workspace write permission.

The original round-1 supervised CLI timed out without a verdict. The immutable recovery report on its former candidate recorded NEEDS_CORRECTION and its OLD Gate was BLOCKED. Neither is reused as approval. This report makes no formal technical acceptance, user personal UX acceptance, merge, main/Stable promotion, or claim that a current Gate was run.
